method: Source traces and connectivity keys identify expected net objects only. Actual native BREP, swept trace copper, pad geometry, layer-specific drill removal and plated barrels form independent physical connectivity graphs. Point-only contacts are rejected. Every individual same-net pad must share one cross-layer graph.
limitations: Ideal CAD copper and plated-barrel continuity only. Does not establish etch tolerances, conductor thermal capacity, firmware behavior, bench continuity or converter stability.
